A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' lived at some point following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. They publicly claimed a rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Jedi Master" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Kieran Yanner]].
